binding_provenance: docs/specs/internal/ops/ml-track/te-new-capabilities-spec.md §4 (locked 2026-05-24, chat QGI-R&D | 002). Pure transform of recipe-similarity-scores artifact; no model re-fit.
m8_r5_note: M8-R5 BINDING: ATTRIBUTION to the similarity score only. signal_share_pct = an indicator's share of this country's total absolute contribution mass (sign indicates direction toward/away from the crisis profile) — this is NOT advice and NOT a probability claim. The model is discriminative, not causal. Never interpret as 'X causes the risk'.
method: Rank indicators by weighted_contribution descending. signal_share_pct = weighted_contribution / sum(|weighted_contribution|) * 100 — share of total ABSOLUTE contribution mass, bounded [-100, +100], |shares| sum to 100%. (Denominator is the absolute mass, NOT the signed sum S, which is incoherent near S=0; review 2026-05-24.) No computation beyond sort + normalize of existing per_indicator data.
